5fcd99d9e78c.zh:
從硬開關到柔性學習
ADALINE · Sigmoid · MLP
5fcd99d9e78c.en:
From Hard Switches to Soft Learning
ADALINE · Sigmoid · MLP

af9538b40733.zh: 先保留分數，再決定答案 Keep the score before making the verdict.
af9538b40733.en: Keep the score first, then decide the answer

2f38459d1de2.zh: 只知對錯，不知錯多少，能學好嗎？<small>Right or wrong — but by how much?</small>
2f38459d1de2.en: If you only know right or wrong, but not how wrong, can you learn well?

a75a92ae451c.zh: 名師導讀 · 鼻祖的壞脾氣 The ancestor's temper
a75a92ae451c.en: Professor's Guide · The Ancestor's Bad Temper

cd83d5432bb5.zh: 前幾節聊了感知機，頂著鼻祖光環，卻有致命老毛病：脾氣太硬、不講道理，非黑即白。Perceptron judges black or white, never shades.
cd83d5432bb5.en: In the previous sections we talked about the perceptron. It wears the halo of the ancestor, yet it has a fatal old flaw: its temper is too hard, it won't listen to reason, and everything is black or white.

83935a2d5d96.zh: 總分沒過門檻直接切成 0，過了就變 1。猜錯時誤差只有離散的對或錯，像只分及格與不及格的老師，不在乎 59 分還是 9 分。Discrete error, same advice for 59 or 9.
83935a2d5d96.en: If the total score doesn't pass the threshold, it is cut straight to 0; if it passes, it becomes 1. When it guesses wrong, the error is only a discrete right or wrong, like a teacher who only sorts students into pass and fail and doesn't care whether you got 59 or 9.

1d85ac5434fa.zh: 硬閾值讓權重更新動作太大，換張新考卷就不會寫：泛化能力差。今天看 1960 年的溫柔革命怎麼收拾爛攤子。Hard steps generalize poorly; 1960 brings softness.
1d85ac5434fa.en: The hard threshold makes the weight updates too big, so give it a new exam paper and it can't answer it: poor generalization. Today we'll see how the gentle revolution of 1960 cleaned up the mess.

516b0a1d369c.zh: 硬閾值 · 錯 1 次或沒錯 Hard and brittle
516b0a1d369c.en: Hard Threshold · Either One Mistake or None

11cd892a04c7.zh: 硬階躍：59 與 9 同判不及格 · Same verdict
11cd892a04c7.en: Hard step: 59 and 9 both get the same fail verdict

dc340de4d71c.zh: 誤差只有對或錯，修正建議長得一樣，更新動作太大，邊界常常學歪。Binary error, oversized updates, skewed borders.
dc340de4d71c.en: The error is only right or wrong, so the correction advice always looks the same, the updates are too big, and the boundary often ends up skewed.

5562dc8feb0d.zh: 像只看及格線的老師：不問你差幾分，錯了就重罰，換卷就倒。A teacher who only sees pass or fail.
5562dc8feb0d.en: Like a teacher who only looks at the passing line: never asks how many points you were short, punishes you hard whenever you're wrong, and you fall apart as soon as the exam paper changes.

e28b4ec46a91.zh: 1960 溫柔革命 · 先別做決定 Decide later
e28b4ec46a91.en: The 1960 Gentle Revolution · Don't Decide Just Yet

4f48e81446bf.zh: Widrow 與 Hoff 提出 ADALINE（自適應線性神經元）：拿尚未套啟用函式、熱騰騰的加權和總分直接跟真實標籤 $y_i$ 相比。Compare the raw score, not the verdict.
4f48e81446bf.en: Widrow and Hoff proposed ADALINE (adaptive linear neuron): take the piping-hot weighted-sum score, before any activation function is applied, and compare it directly with the true label $y_i$.

81cdaf13ad96.zh: 做完決定才比對：二元輸出 0/1 對標籤 — decide first
81cdaf13ad96.en: Decide first, then compare: the binary 0/1 output is checked against the label

e82e7cf0e54d.zh: 誤差離散：只知對錯 — binary
e82e7cf0e54d.en: Discrete error: it only knows right or wrong

4a3dc0219de0.zh: 硬碰硬更新 — harsh steps

c544ef75a5f5.zh: 先比對再決定：加權和總分對標籤 — score first
c544ef75a5f5.en: Compare first, then decide: the weighted-sum score is checked against the label

4d6d14fd76ac.zh: 誤差連續：知道少幾分 — how much
4d6d14fd76ac.en: Continuous error: it knows how many points it is short

2449f714404c.zh: 平滑溫柔更新 — smooth steps

d25bdb231e9b.zh: 真實 170，感知機只猜高於 160 與否；ADALINE 猜 165，誤差 5，猜 175，誤差 -5。連續誤差讓調整更平滑，泛化更好。Continuous error guides gentle tuning.
d25bdb231e9b.en: The true height is 170; the perceptron only guesses whether it is above 160 or not. ADALINE guesses 165, error 5; guesses 175, error -5. Continuous error makes the adjustments smoother and generalization better.

50fca888fed1.zh: 溫柔的開關 · Sigmoid A gentle switch

451d811bffbc.zh: 硬閾值只給答案；Sigmoid 保留信心程度 · Decision versus confidence
451d811bffbc.en: The hard threshold gives only an answer; the sigmoid keeps the degree of confidence

92ed5eede89c.zh: $e\approx2.71828$；輸出永遠落在 $(0,1)$，因此可以讀成機率。A bounded score that reads like probability.
92ed5eede89c.en: $e\approx2.71828$; the output always falls in $(0,1)$, so it can be read as a probability.

e0f22ee0efd0.zh: 為何更容易學 · Why it learns

c2f6c2e05f56.zh: 錯誤不再只有「錯／對」兩種聲音，而是能告訴模型「差多少」；小幅、連續的梯度讓更新更平滑。Continuous error gives smoother updates.
c2f6c2e05f56.en: Errors no longer speak with only two voices, “wrong/right”; they can tell the model “by how much”. Small, continuous gradients make the updates smoother.

215545cc5ef7.zh: 手算誤差 · 紅蘋果打幾分 Score the apple
215545cc5ef7.en: Computing the Error by Hand · How Many Points Does the Red Apple Get?

a1f8d52ea8cf.zh: $z = w_1 x_1 + w_0 = 0.5 \times 10 + 1 = \mathbf{6}$，此處停住，還沒套開關。Raw score 6, no squash yet.
a1f8d52ea8cf.en: $z = w_1 x_1 + w_0 = 0.5 \times 10 + 1 = \mathbf{6}$. We stop here: the switch hasn't been applied yet.

27ef9c294f48.zh: 真實 $y_i = 10$，連續誤差 $10 - 6 = \mathbf{4}$，清楚知道少打 4 分。Short by exactly 4.
27ef9c294f48.en: The true $y_i = 10$, so the continuous error is $10 - 6 = \mathbf{4}$: we know clearly that the score fell 4 points short.

0840eefd1a37.zh: 感知機只會喊錯或對；ADALINE 的 4 分資訊就是泛化更強的秘密。Four points of extra signal.
0840eefd1a37.en: The perceptron can only shout wrong or right; ADALINE's 4 points of information are the secret to its stronger generalization.

2f15ae7079ae.zh: 離散 vs 連續誤差 · Discrete versus continuous

17ec44328a93.zh: 數值推論 · 神經元怎麼認出紅蘋果？ A numerical walkthrough
17ec44328a93.en: A Numerical Walkthrough · How Does a Neuron Recognize a Red Apple?

9afba6a24e5f.zh: $o=\sigma(1)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-1}}\approx\mathbf{0.731}$，模型有 73.1% 信心認為它是紅蘋果。The model says 73.1%.
9afba6a24e5f.en: $o=\sigma(1)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-1}}\approx\mathbf{0.731}$: the model is 73.1% confident that it is a red apple.

3eabb1d9202d.zh: $\sigma'(z)=\sigma(z)(1-\sigma(z))\approx0.1966$；梯度會隨信心程度連續變化。The slope stays measurable.
3eabb1d9202d.en: $\sigma'(z)=\sigma(z)(1-\sigma(z))\approx0.1966$; the gradient changes continuously with the degree of confidence.

30fefba7b536.zh: 一致的更新示例 · A consistent update

aa5087bbdd22.zh: 若使用二元交叉熵，$\frac{\partial L}{\partial \beta_1}=(o-y)x_1=(0.731-1)\times8\approx-2.152$。學習率 $\eta=0.1$ 時，$\beta_1^{new}=0.5-\eta\frac{\partial L}{\partial\beta_1}\approx\mathbf{0.715}$。Gradient descent nudges the weight upward toward the positive label.
aa5087bbdd22.en: If we use binary cross-entropy, $\frac{\partial L}{\partial \beta_1}=(o-y)x_1=(0.731-1)\times8\approx-2.152$. With learning rate $\eta=0.1$, $\beta_1^{new}=0.5-\eta\frac{\partial L}{\partial\beta_1}\approx\mathbf{0.715}$.

c4c229d94696.zh: 避免混淆 · Keep the models separate

1171a4e9a1b2.zh: ADALINE 的經典訓練物件是未套啟用函式的線性輸出與 LMS；Sigmoid 則把線性總分轉成機率。兩者都保留連續資訊，但損失函式與更新式不能混寫。ADALINE/LMS and logistic/Sigmoid are related, not identical.
1171a4e9a1b2.en: ADALINE's classic training target is the linear output with no activation function applied, together with LMS; the sigmoid instead turns the linear score into a probability. Both keep continuous information, but their loss functions and update rules must not be mixed up.

651aece1bdf1.zh: LMS 二次損失 · 碗裝誤差 A bowl of errors
651aece1bdf1.en: LMS Quadratic Loss · A Bowl of Errors

7480c88ea064.zh: 別管正負號，誤差平方再求和：懲罰離群值，圖形是平滑拋物線，好處理。Square, sum, smooth bowl.
7480c88ea064.en: Never mind the sign: square the errors and add them up. This penalizes outliers, and the graph is a smooth parabola that is easy to work with.

fdbd2aa2e44b.zh: 左硬階躍離散 · 右拋物線碗與梯度路徑 · matplotlib 精準繪製
fdbd2aa2e44b.en: Left: discrete hard step · Right: parabolic bowl with the gradient path · drawn precisely with matplotlib

daa1dc50e9f9.zh: 平方放大離群懲罰，且處處可微，梯度明確，替下降法鋪路。Outliers hurt more; gradients exist.
daa1dc50e9f9.en: Squaring amplifies the penalty on outliers, and it is differentiable everywhere, so the gradient is well defined, paving the way for descent methods.

192d036979da.zh: 連續總分直接比標籤，誤差連續，更新溫柔。Compare raw, update gently.
192d036979da.en: Compare the continuous score directly with the label: the error is continuous and the updates are gentle.

cf5c5c4f3b8d.zh: 梯度下降 · 順坡滑下山谷 Slide downhill
cf5c5c4f3b8d.en: Gradient Descent · Sliding Down the Slope into the Valley

fc95d6193f68.zh: 梯度與更新 · Gradient and update

cffbd28b4b7e.zh: 梯度是山坡最陡方向；誤差乘輸入即貢獻度，沿反方向滑向谷底，$\eta$ 決定步幅。Steepest slope reversed; eta sets stride.
cffbd28b4b7e.en: The gradient is the steepest direction of the hillside; error times input is the contribution, so we slide in the opposite direction toward the valley floor, and $\eta$ sets the step size.

5b21ea587b07.zh: LMS / Widrow-Hoff 法則是現代所有梯度下降最佳化器的早期雛形：平滑溫柔改錯，不硬碰硬。Ancestor of every optimizer.
5b21ea587b07.en: The LMS / Widrow-Hoff rule is the early prototype of every modern gradient-descent optimizer: it corrects mistakes smoothly and gently, instead of meeting force with force.

0a7e57afaf96.zh: 邊界對比 · 學歪 vs 穩健 Skewed versus steady

58b2a17e93ff.zh: 左感知機邊界學歪 · 右 ADALINE 更穩健 · matplotlib 精準繪製
58b2a17e93ff.en: Left: the perceptron boundary ends up skewed · Right: ADALINE is more robust · drawn precisely with matplotlib

4ce1011657cc.zh: 雖能切開訓練集，但離散誤差讓邊界學歪，新資料一來就破功。Cuts training, fails fresh data.
4ce1011657cc.en: It can separate the training set, but the discrete error leaves the boundary skewed, and it falls apart as soon as new data arrives.

69421cf91908.zh: 連續誤差加梯度下降畫出更穩健的邊界，沒見過的資料表現更好。Smooth error, steadier border.
69421cf91908.en: Continuous error plus gradient descent draws a more robust boundary that performs better on data it has never seen.

9b7cd38624a0.zh: XOR 幾何難題 · 為何需要 MLP？ Why hidden layers matter
9b7cd38624a0.en: The Geometric Puzzle of XOR · Why Do We Need an MLP?

1fdaf9a7d119.zh: AND 可由一條直線分開；XOR 需要隱藏層折疊空間 · Linear versus multilayer geometry
1fdaf9a7d119.en: AND can be separated by one straight line; XOR needs a hidden layer to fold the space

a499ac24ed64.zh: 權重 $[1,1]$、偏置 $-1.5$ 給出 $x_1+x_2=1.5$；唯一的 1 點與三個 0 點可被一刀切開。One hyperplane is enough.
a499ac24ed64.en: Weights $[1,1]$ and bias $-1.5$ give $x_1+x_2=1.5$; the single 1 point and the three 0 points can be separated with one cut.

373206f489f1.zh: 兩個正例位在對角線，任何單一直線都會漏掉一個角；MLP 用隱藏層組合多個邊界。Hidden layers compose boundaries.
373206f489f1.en: The two positive examples sit on a diagonal, so any single straight line will miss one corner; an MLP uses a hidden layer to combine several boundaries.

2cb39aaa9c12.zh: 單層神經元只能做一次線性切割；多層網路則能先折疊，再在新的表示空間切割。Fold first, separate later.
2cb39aaa9c12.en: A single-layer neuron can make only one linear cut; a multilayer network can first fold the space, then cut it in the new representation space.

188115ba6ca4.zh: MADALINE · 溫柔且強大 Gentle and strong

ce1edd997403.zh: 堆疊溫柔單元，處理非線性任務
ce1edd997403.en: Stack gentle units to handle nonlinear tasks

b7e8c74623cf.zh: MADALINE：最早的多層嘗試 · Early deep stack

be10b36fd4e3.zh: 1962 MRI 只能調前段；1988 MRII 前後皆可調；1990 MRIII 更深層全面可訓。Tunable range keeps growing.
be10b36fd4e3.en: 1962 MRI could tune only the front part; 1988 MRII could tune both the front and the back; 1990 MRIII made deeper layers fully trainable.

b26c7650308f.zh: 反向傳播還沒流行，MADALINE 已證明：簡單單元分層堆疊是處理複雜問題的正確道路。Stacking simple units works.
b26c7650308f.en: Before backpropagation became popular, MADALINE had already shown that stacking simple units in layers is the right road to solving complex problems.

fff377d24ed9.zh: 命運分岔 · 硬 vs 溫柔 Hard versus gentle
fff377d24ed9.en: A Fork in Fate · Hard vs. Gentle

e0c37d2536f2.zh: 硬更新，依賴二元啟用 — hard steps
e0c37d2536f2.en: Hard updates that rely on a binary activation

07724d8b75a8.zh: 邊界易學歪，泛化差 — skewed, fragile
07724d8b75a8.en: The boundary easily ends up skewed; poor generalization

20f1c9e5bbc7.zh: 平滑梯度下降，連續誤差 — smooth descent
20f1c9e5bbc7.en: Smooth gradient descent with continuous error

1a1125c101d9.zh: 邊界穩健，新資料更好 — steady, generalizes
1a1125c101d9.en: A robust boundary that does better on new data

a55607995fb7.zh: 從硬閾值感知到連續自適應學習：先量誤差，再做決定。Measure first, decide later.
a55607995fb7.en: From hard-threshold perception to continuous adaptive learning: measure the error first, then make the decision.

84835cb0d400.zh: 鼻祖登場，硬閾值非黑即白。Hard ancestor arrives.
84835cb0d400.en: The ancestor arrives: a hard threshold, everything black or white.

eb4bac773ff7.zh: 連續誤差加梯度，分層堆疊擴大可訓範圍。Smooth error, growing stack.
eb4bac773ff7.en: Continuous error plus gradients; stacking in layers widens what can be trained.

b16bf6cb9d3a.zh: 下節用摺紙藝術解決 XOR 難題。Next: fold away XOR.
b16bf6cb9d3a.en: Next section: we solve the XOR puzzle with the art of paper folding.

2391467faf5e.zh: 思考題 · 提取練習 Reflection

094aa9d17af8.zh: Q1. ADALINE 與感知機的最大不同？ Key difference?
094aa9d17af8.en: Q1. What is the biggest difference between ADALINE and the perceptron?

c5dc8933d322.zh: 層數更多 — more layers

2c3524e35152.zh: 拿未套啟用的加權和比標籤 — raw score first
2c3524e35152.en: It compares the weighted sum, before any activation, with the label

c47364a56278.zh: 不用權重 — no weights

81cad92694aa.zh: Q2. 紅蘋果例中連續誤差是多少？ Apple error?
81cad92694aa.en: Q2. In the red-apple example, what is the continuous error?

0666cc9848bd.zh: Q3. MADALINE 的歷史意義？ Why MADALINE matters?
0666cc9848bd.en: Q3. What is the historical significance of MADALINE?

7476430cffb5.zh: 證明分層堆疊簡單單元是正確道路 — stacking works
7476430cffb5.en: It proved that stacking simple units in layers is the right road

2029a4f6df1b.zh: 證明單層就夠 — one layer enough
2029a4f6df1b.en: It proved that a single layer is enough

14a00e1ae687.zh: 發明 GPU — invented GPU
